4-islands.title: 4 Islands Tour from Koh Lanta | Secret Travel & Tour
4-islands.metaDescription: 4 Islands tour from Koh Lanta by longtail or speedboat: Koh Chueak, Koh Mook Emerald Cave, Koh Ngai, Koh Ma or Kradan. Lunch included. Price on WhatsApp.
4-islands.lead: Koh Chueak, Koh Mook and its Emerald Cave, Koh Ngai, then Koh Ma or Koh Kradan. A full day on the water, by longtail or speedboat, private or join-in.
intro: The 4 Islands sit south of Koh Lanta, in the Trang sea. The longtail route stops at Koh Chueak, Koh Mook, Koh Ngai and Koh Ma. The speedboat route swaps Koh Ma for Koh Kradan. On a private longtail you can add Koh Kradan as a detour.
At Koh Mook you swim through the Emerald Cave and come out in a lagoon enclosed by cliffs. Lunch is a Thai buffet on the beach, on Koh Ngai with the longtail and on Koh Kradan with the speedboat.

day.text: Pickup at your hotel between 7:45 and 8:30, then the pier (Old Town for the longtail, Rattana Pier for the speedboat).
The boat leaves. The longtail takes about 45 minutes to reach the first island.
Koh Chueak, snorkeling over the reef, about 45 minutes.
Koh Mook, swim through the Emerald Cave to the hidden lagoon.
Lunch buffet on the beach, then swimming and time to do nothing.
One more island and one more snorkeling stop: Koh Ma on the longtail, Koh Ngai on the speedboat.
Back on Koh Lanta between 15:30 and 16:00, transfer to your hotel.

included: Thai buffet lunch on the beach, water and fruit
On a private boat: the boat and the captain for your group only
notIncluded: National park fee, paid in cash on the island
4-islands.parkFee: 200 THB per adult and 100 THB per child (Thai nationals 40 and 20 THB)
goodToKnow: Join-in or private. On a private longtail the schedule is flexible and you choose the order of the islands.
Children have their own rate. Babies under 4 go free on the longtail. Tell us the ages when you ask for a price.
Times vary a little with the sea and the season. The return is usually between 14:30 and 16:00.

faq.q: Longtail or speedboat for the 4 Islands?
faq.a: The longtail is the traditional wooden boat, slower and open, and it visits Koh Ma. The speedboat is faster and visits Koh Kradan instead. Both include lunch and snorkel gear.

faq.q: Is the 4 Islands tour private?
faq.a: Both exist. You can join a group or take the boat for your group only, with a dedicated captain.

faq.q: Is the national park fee included?
faq.a: No. No operator on Koh Lanta includes it. You pay 200 THB per adult and 100 THB per child in cash to the ranger on the island.

faq.q: Can children come?
faq.a: Yes. Children pay a child rate and babies under 4 travel free on the longtail. Life jackets are on board. Give us the ages when you ask for a price.

4-islands.caption: Koh Ngai

koh-rok-koh-haa.title: Koh Rok & Koh Haa Day Trip | Secret Travel & Tour
koh-rok-koh-haa.metaDescription: Koh Rok and Koh Haa from Koh Lanta, October to April, by speedboat or private longtail. Snorkeling and lunch on the beach. Get a price on WhatsApp.
koh-rok-koh-haa.lead: Two islands of the Mu Ko Lanta National Park, open from October to April, by speedboat or private longtail. Snorkeling stops and lunch on the beach of Koh Rok.
intro: Koh Rok is two islands, Koh Rok Nok and Koh Rok Nai, about an hour and a half south of Koh Lanta by longtail and less by speedboat. Koh Haa, the Five Islands, has a turquoise lagoon for the last snorkeling stop on the way back.
The park is closed in the rainy season. Tours run from October to April.

day.text: Pickup at your hotel around 8:00, light breakfast at Rattana Pier.
The speedboat leaves for Koh Rok.
Two snorkeling stops over the coral around Koh Rok.
Lunch buffet on the beach of Koh Rok, swimming, and the monitor lizards that live on the island.
Koh Haa and a third snorkeling stop in the lagoon.
Back on Koh Lanta around 15:30, at your hotel by 16:30.

included: Thai buffet lunch on the beach, water and fruit
notIncluded: National park fee, paid in cash on the island
koh-rok-koh-haa.parkFee: 400 THB per adult and 200 THB per child (Thai nationals 40 and 20 THB)
goodToKnow: Private longtail option: Koh Rok only, 8:00 to 16:00, about 1h30 each way, your group only.
Private speedboat option: your group only, 9:00 to 16:00.
A later version with a sunset stop also exists on some days. Ask us.
Children from 4 to 11 pay a child rate on the speedboat.

faq.q: When can you go to Koh Rok?
faq.a: From October to April. The national park closes the islands during the rainy season.

faq.q: How long is the boat ride to Koh Rok?
faq.a: About an hour and a half by longtail. The speedboat is faster.

faq.q: Is the national park fee included?
faq.a: No. You pay 400 THB per adult and 200 THB per child in cash to the ranger on Koh Rok.

faq.q: Speedboat or longtail?
faq.a: The join-in trip is by speedboat and includes Koh Haa. The private longtail goes to Koh Rok only, at your own pace.

koh-rok-koh-haa.caption: Koh Rok

koh-phi-phi.title: Koh Phi Phi Day Trip from Koh Lanta | Secret Travel
koh-phi-phi.metaDescription: Koh Phi Phi from Koh Lanta by speedboat: Maya Bay, Pileh Lagoon, Monkey Beach, Bamboo Island, snorkeling and lunch on Phi Phi Don. Get a price on WhatsApp.
koh-phi-phi.lead: Maya Bay, Pileh Lagoon, Viking Cave, Monkey Beach, then lunch on Phi Phi Don and an afternoon on Bamboo Island. By speedboat, join-in or private.
intro: Phi Phi is north of Koh Lanta. The speedboat crosses in about an hour. The morning is spent around Phi Phi Leh, the island with Maya Bay and Pileh Lagoon. After lunch on Phi Phi Don, the afternoon goes to Bamboo Island, with snorkeling from the beach.

day.text: Pickup at your hotel between 8:00 and 9:00, light breakfast at Rattana Pier.
Crossing to Phi Phi Leh.
Maya Bay, Viking Cave, Pileh Lagoon, Monkey Beach and a snorkeling stop.
Lunch buffet on Phi Phi Don, free time on the beach.
Bamboo Island, swimming and snorkeling from the beach.
Snorkeling at Loh Mudee Bay.
Back towards Koh Lanta, at your hotel around 16:30.

included: Thai buffet lunch, water and fruit
notIncluded: National park fee, paid in cash
koh-phi-phi.parkFee: 400 THB per adult and 200 THB per child (Thai nationals 40 and 20 THB)
goodToKnow: Private speedboat option, 9:00 to 16:00, your group only.
Children from 4 to 11 pay a child rate.
Maya Bay has its own rules set by the national park. The stop depends on the day and the season.

faq.q: How far is Phi Phi from Koh Lanta?
faq.a: About an hour by speedboat from Rattana Pier.

faq.q: Do we stop at Maya Bay?
faq.a: Yes, in the morning, with Viking Cave, Pileh Lagoon and Monkey Beach. Access to Maya Bay follows the national park rules of the day.

faq.q: Is the national park fee included?
faq.a: No. You pay 400 THB per adult and 200 THB per child in cash.

faq.q: Can we have the boat for ourselves?
faq.a: Yes. A private speedboat runs from 9:00 to 16:00 with a guide for your group only.

koh-phi-phi.caption: Phi Phi

koh-talabeng-koh-bubu.title: Koh Talabeng Kayak & Koh Bubu | Secret Travel & Tour
koh-talabeng-koh-bubu.metaDescription: Half-day longtail trip from Koh Lanta: kayaking around the limestone islets of Koh Talabeng, then a beach stop on Koh Bubu. Lunch included. Price on WhatsApp.
koh-talabeng-koh-bubu.lead: A half day on the east side of Koh Lanta. You paddle around the limestone islets of Koh Talabeng, then the longtail takes you to the beach of Koh Bubu.
intro: Koh Talabeng is a group of limestone islets off the east coast of Koh Lanta. You paddle around them by kayak. Koh Bubu is a small island nearby, reached by longtail, with a beach for the stop.

day.text: Pickup at your hotel, then the longtail from the east coast.
Kayaking around the limestone islets of Koh Talabeng.
Longtail to Koh Bubu, lunch and time on the beach.
Back to Koh Lanta and your hotel.

included: Kayaks, masks, snorkels and life jackets
goodToKnow: Half day, by longtail.
Tell us if you have never kayaked. The kayaks are two-seaters.
Tell us the ages of children when you ask for a price.

faq.q: How long is the Koh Talabeng trip?
faq.a: Half a day, with hotel pickup and return.

faq.q: Do I need kayaking experience?
faq.a: No. Tell us if it is your first time and you will share a two-seater kayak.

koh-talabeng-koh-bubu.caption: Talabeng

mangroves.title: Koh Lanta Mangrove Tour | Secret Travel & Tour
mangroves.metaDescription: Mangrove trips at Thung Yee Peng, Koh Lanta: private wooden raft at sunrise or sunset, longtail, or kayak among monkeys and crabs. Get a price on WhatsApp.
mangroves.lead: The mangrove on the east side of Koh Lanta, by longtail, on a private wooden raft, or by kayak. Half a day, or just a sunrise.
intro: Thung Yee Peng is a village on the east coast of Koh Lanta with a protected mangrove behind it. The channels are calm. You see monkeys, birds and fiddler crabs on the mud at low tide.

Three ways to go. A longtail runs through the main channels. A private wooden raft, poled slowly, leaves from Thung Yee Peng pier for a sunrise, a fishing morning or a dinner at sunset. A kayak gets you into the narrow channels.

day.text: Sunrise raft. On the water by 5:30, sunrise around 6:00 over the mountains, light breakfast on the raft (coffee, tea, snacks), back at the hotel by 7:30.
Fishing raft. Fishing in the waters of Ao Lanta, a look at how the local fishermen work, a seafood lunch cooked on the raft, back around 14:00.
Sunset raft. Sunset on the river, seafood dinner by candlelight, then the bioluminescent plankton in the dark water, back by 20:00.

included: On the raft: breakfast, lunch or dinner depending on the programme, drinks and fruit
Kayaks and life jackets on the kayak trip
goodToKnow: The raft is private, for your group only. Prices are per group of one or two, then per extra person. Children from 3 to 9 have a child rate.
The kayak can be combined with an hour of ATV in the forest, two hours in all.
Bring mosquito repellent for sunrise and sunset.

faq.q: Which mangrove trip should I pick?
faq.a: The raft is the quietest, with the sunrise and the sunset dinner as its two programmes. The kayak is more active and reaches the narrow channels. The longtail is the simplest with children.

faq.q: Can we see the plankton?
faq.a: On the sunset dinner programme, once it is dark, the plankton lights up when the water moves.

faq.q: How early is the sunrise trip?
faq.a: Pickup is around 4:40 and you are back at the hotel by 7:30, in time for a second breakfast.

mangroves.caption: Thung Yee Peng

fishing-trip.title: Fishing Trip from Koh Lanta | Secret Travel & Tour
fishing-trip.metaDescription: Half-day fishing off Koh Lanta on a longtail, or on a private wooden raft in Ao Lanta with a seafood lunch cooked on board. Get a price on WhatsApp.
fishing-trip.lead: A half day of fishing the way the island does it: from a longtail off the coast, or from a private wooden raft in the calm waters of Ao Lanta, with lunch cooked on board.
intro: Two versions. The longtail goes out to sea off Koh Lanta with a local captain. The raft stays in the sheltered bay of Ao Lanta, on the mangrove side, and the crew cooks fresh seafood on board for lunch.

day.text: Pickup at your hotel around 9:30, check-in at Thung Yee Peng pier at 10:00.
The raft crosses the mangrove forest.
Fishing in Ao Lanta.
A look at how the local fishermen live and work.
Seafood lunch cooked on the raft, drinks and fruit.
More fishing, swimming or photos, back at the pier at 14:00 and transfer to your hotel.

included: On the raft: seafood lunch, drinks and fruit
goodToKnow: The raft is private, from one or two people, with a rate per extra person. Children from 3 to 9 have a child rate.
The longtail trip is a half day too. Tell us which one you prefer, or ask us which suits your group.

faq.q: Do I need fishing experience?
faq.a: No. The captain shows you how to use the gear.

faq.q: Do we eat what we catch?
faq.a: On the raft the lunch is fresh seafood cooked on board. On the longtail, ask us.

fishing-trip.caption: Sunset catch

elephant-sanctuary.title: Ethical Elephant Sanctuary Koh Lanta | Secret Travel
elephant-sanctuary.metaDescription: Lanta Elephant Sanctuary: walk with the elephants, feed them, mud bath, no riding. From 1h30 to a full day, hotel transfer included. Price on WhatsApp.
elephant-sanctuary.lead: Walk with the elephants, feed them, join them in the mud bath and the pool. Nobody rides. Three programmes, from an hour and a half to a full day.
intro: Lanta Elephant Sanctuary is on Koh Lanta. There is no riding and no show. You spend the time next to the animals, feeding them bananas, walking with them and washing them.
Sessions start at 7:30, 10:00 and 13:00. Come in clothes that can get dirty and wet, with a towel and flip-flops.

day.text: About 1h30 to 2 hours: walk with the elephants, feeding, mud bath, bathing together in the pool. Fresh fruit and water for you, bananas for them.
About 3 hours, at 7:30 or 13:00: everything in A, plus making traditional herbal remedies and paper from elephant dung, which you take home. Coffee and tea.
Full day from 7:30: everything in B, plus a Thai set lunch, a swim at the Emerald Pool and the hot spring waterfall. Two people per session at most, booked ahead.

included: Programme C: lunch and the entrance fees
goodToKnow: Children from 4 to 10 pay a child rate. Under 4 go free.
Programme C takes two people per session only. Book it early.
You will get muddy. Bring a change of clothes.

faq.q: Is there any riding?
faq.a: No. You walk with the elephants, feed them and wash them. Nobody sits on them.

faq.q: How long does it take?
faq.a: From an hour and a half for Programme A to a full day for Programme C, plus the transfer from your hotel.

faq.q: Is it suitable for small children?
faq.a: Yes. Children from 4 pay a child rate and under 4 go free. They stay next to you the whole time.

elephant-sanctuary.caption: No riding

cooking-class.title: Thai Cooking Class Koh Lanta | Secret Travel & Tour
cooking-class.metaDescription: Thai cooking class on Koh Lanta: market visit, then four dishes with homemade curry paste. Transfer, apron and recipe booklet included. Price on WhatsApp.
cooking-class.lead: A morning at the market, then four dishes you cook yourself with a local cook: a starter, a soup and two mains with curry paste made from scratch. Then you eat it all.
intro: The class is held by Sukho Cuisine on Koh Lanta. The morning class runs on Mondays, Wednesdays and Saturdays from 9:00 to about 14:00, market visit first. You leave with your apron, a recipe booklet, a certificate and a box for what you could not finish.
The school also teaches fruit and vegetable carving, with your creations to take home, on weekday mornings or afternoons depending on the day.

day.text: Pickup at your hotel, welcome drinks and snacks at the school.
Visit to the local market to pick the ingredients.
Cooking: four dishes, including two mains with a curry paste pounded by hand.
Lunch with what you cooked, then transfer back to your hotel around 14:00.

included: Apron to keep, recipe booklet, certificate
Box to take your dishes home
goodToKnow: Suitable for children.
Morning class on Mondays, Wednesdays and Saturdays. An evening class also exists. Ask us for the days.
Carving class: Mondays, Wednesdays and Saturdays from 15:00 to 18:00, Tuesdays, Thursdays and Fridays from 9:00 to 12:00.

faq.q: What do we cook?
faq.a: Four dishes: a starter, a soup and two main courses, with the curry paste made by hand during the class.

faq.q: Can children join?
faq.a: Yes. The class is suitable for children. Tell us their ages.

faq.q: Is the market visit included?
faq.a: Yes, in the morning class. You go to the local market with the cook before cooking.

cooking-class.caption: Market day

atv.title: ATV Quad Ride Koh Lanta | Secret Travel & Tour
atv.metaDescription: ATV on Koh Lanta: 30 minutes on a closed track, an hour on forest trails to a sea viewpoint, or ATV plus mangrove kayak. Transfer included. Price on WhatsApp.
atv.lead: Thirty minutes on a closed track, an hour on the forest trails up to a viewpoint over the sea, or an hour of ATV followed by an hour of kayak in the mangrove.
intro: Lanta ATV Adventure runs the rides, with a guide, safety gear and a hotel transfer. Open all year. Children can ride as passengers from 4 and drive from 6 with closer supervision from the staff.

day.text: On a closed, secured track. The ride for a first try.
On the forest trails, with the climb to a viewpoint over the sea.
One hour of ATV in the forest, then one hour of kayak in the protected mangrove of Thung Yee Peng, with its monkeys and fiddler crabs.

included: Kayak and life jacket on the combined ride
goodToKnow: No children under 4. Passengers from 4, drivers from 6 with staff supervision.
Cancel at least 24 hours ahead. Later than that, half the ride is charged.
Closed shoes and clothes that can get dusty.

faq.q: Can children drive?
faq.a: From 6, with closer supervision from the staff. Younger children ride as passengers from 4. Under 4 cannot come.

faq.q: Which ride should I pick?
faq.a: The 30-minute track is for a first try. The one-hour forest ride gets you to the viewpoint. The two-hour ride adds the mangrove by kayak.

atv.caption: Viewpoint
